notes.title: KRUNCH in the Humble Weekly, Trading Cards and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]KRUNCH is part of this week's Humble Weekly[/h1]
Thanks to our pals over at [b]Devolver Digital[/b], KRUNCH is part of the [b]"Oh Man, You Should Totally Check That Game Out!"[/b] Humble Weekly Bundle!
 
Pay what you want. Support charity. Totally get seven sweet games:
[b][url=https://www.humblebundle.com/weekly]Humble Bundle[/url][/b]

[h1]Trading Cards are now available for KRUNCH![/h1]
We teamed up once again with the supremely talented [b][url=http://www.twobitart.com]Two Bit Art[/url][/b] and she delivered 6 awesome renditions of our Krons to grace the cards. Go grab yours and please spread the word.

[h1]Build 111: Bug Fixes + Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]All Kreb Collection Achievements unlock properly now.
[*]Leaderboard are now accessible from the Title Screen.
[*]Level Select Leaderboards are now tracked in milliseconds:
[list]
[*]All Level Select Leaderboards have been flushed
[*][b]NO WORRIES[/b]: your best times will be uploaded the next time you play that level :)
[/list]
[*]A weird bug that would prevent the game from launching on OSX is now fixed.
[*]Pressing K now self-destructs properly.
[*]A few [i]behind the scenes[/i] bugs have been squashed.
[/list]

notes.title: Upgrading to Digital Collector's Edition - Take 2
notes.content:
Having explored + tested our options with Valve, we have concluded that due to technical difficulties, we are unable to offer a direct upgrade path to the Digital Collector's Edtion of KRUNCH right on Steam.

If you are interested in upgrading your copy (regardless of where you purchased KRUNCH), please contact us directly at [b]upgrade@legrudgerugged.com[/b] and we'll be happy to sell you a key outside of Steam.

notes.title: Upgrading to Digital Collector's Edition
notes.content:
[h1]IF PURCHASED ON STEAM[/h1]
if you purchased a non-collector copy of KRUNCH on Steam, go ahead and purchase a Digital Collector's Edition copy. Then, contact Steam support for a refund of the original purchase.

[h1]IF RECEIVED KEY FROM PREVIOUS PURCHASE[/h1]
If you got a Steam key from Indie Royale, IndieGameStand, Greenlight Bundle, Humble Store or KrunchGame.com, you may purchase a copy of the soundtrack on our [url=http://legrudgerugged.bandcamp.com]Bandcamp page[/url]. The Digital Comic is a Steam exclusive.

[h1]BUY A LIMITED COLLECTOR'S EDITION[/h1]
You could always buy one of our limited, signed + numbered hard-copy Collector's Editions :) This gets you:  large jewel case, game on CD, soundtrack on CD, 32-page comic book, art prints, poster of all boss maps, stickers, digital wallpapers and Steam key: [url=http://KrunchGame.com]KrunchGame.com[/url]

notes.title: KRUNCH keys for previous purchases
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that it is our intention to grant Steam keys to all previous KRUNCH purchasers (regardless of the source). We have requested keys from Steam, contacted all third-party distributors and hope that you don't have to wait too long to get a key. In the event you can't wait any longer, please buy another copy :) we would be forever grateful.

[list]
[*] Keys from Steam: [b]RECEIVED![/b]
[*] KrunchGame.com: [b]AVAILABLE![/b]
[*] Humble Store: [b]PROCESSING[/b]
[*] Indie Royale: [b]AVAILABLE![/b]
[*] Indie Game Stand: [b]AVAILABLE![/b]
[*] Greenlight Bundle: [b]AVAILABLE![/b]
[/list]
